title: lobelia gregoriana subsp. elgonensis
intro: Lobelia gregoriana subsp. elgonensis, commonly known as Elgon Lobelia, is a plant species of the Lobelia genus. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Elgon Lobelia include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as analgesia, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects. The plant is also believed to have potential therapeutic applications in treating various conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues.
